_doc: MP4/5 with its wing elements rebuilt as clean aerofoils (geometry/wing_rebuild.py, "wing_rebuild": true): the model's front main plane is S-shaped (camber of the wrong sign over its front half) and the 2D sections of all four F1 showed the drawn geometry, not y+ or the mesh, as the cause of the separated wings (the MCL39 control stays attached at any y+). Each element keeps the model's leading and trailing edge per station (chord, incidence, span) and gets an inverted NACA 4-digit section (main planes 4 % camber, flaps 6 %, thickness = model median clamped to 9-15 %). mp45_w1 = the p14 settings; s2dw_mp45 = the 2D sections at the p14 stations on the rebuilt wings.
